theme.description: Strict monochromatic architectural identity derived from the SEPTA geometric logo symbol. Built form, blueprints, structured geometry, precision lines, zero decorative color gradients or rounded bubbly UI.

logo_specification.style: Grey line-work mark (#606060) on transparent/black background. Used on both dark and light sections.
logo_specification.wordmark: SEPTA GROUP set in Space Grotesk, uppercase, font-weight 500, letter-spacing 0.08em.

rules: Monochrome is intentional. Do NOT introduce permanent colorful accents or neon highlights.
Contrast is achieved via high-contrast typography, structural grey hierarchy (#606060), and high-quality architectural photography.
Dark Sections: bg #050505, primary text #FFFFFF, secondary text #A8A8A8, borders rgba(255,255,255,0.14).
Light Sections: bg #F6F6F3 or #FFFFFF, primary text #111111, secondary text #666666, borders #DADAD7.
Avoid pure #000 on pure #FFF everywhere; use subtle tonal separation like #F6F6F3 and #050505.

families.display: Space Grotesk, sans-serif (H1, H2, H3, numerical statements, nav emphasis)
families.body: Inter, sans-serif (paragraphs, forms, buttons, long-form content)
families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, monospace (project categories, sqft, dates, locations, section indices, technical metadata)

rules: DO NOT use fonts outside of Space Grotesk, Inter, and IBM Plex Mono.
Headlines function as architectural structures: e.g. 'FROM IDEA / TO INFRASTRUCTURE.', 'ONE PARTNER. / THE ENTIRE PROJECT.'
Avoid paragraph-length hero headlines; let empty space be part of the composition.

type_scale.page_h1: font-display text-[64px] lg:text-[88px] font-medium leading-[0.98] tracking-[-0.045em]
type_scale.section_h2: font-display text-[42px] lg:text-[64px] font-medium leading-[1.02] tracking-[-0.035em]
type_scale.technical_label: font-mono text-[11px] lg:text-[13px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-neutral-500

borders_and_dividers.shadows: NO drop shadows, no heavy neumorphism, no floating glass blur cards. All elements anchored strictly to the grid.

corner_radius.banned: No rounded-xl (20px/30px/999px) bubbly buttons or card wraps.

button_primitives.primary_dark_bg: bg-white text-[#050505] border border-white hover:bg-transparent hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200 rounded-[3px] px-6 py-3.5 font-medium flex items-center gap-2
button_primitives.primary_light_bg: bg-[#050505] text-white border border-[#050505] hover:bg-transparent hover:text-[#050505] transition-colors duration-200 rounded-[3px] px-6 py-3.5 font-medium flex items-center gap-2
button_primitives.secondary: bg-transparent text-current border border-current hover:bg-neutral-900/10 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors duration-200 rounded-[3px] px-6 py-3.5 font-medium flex items-center gap-2
button_primitives.arrow_icon_behavior: Include minimalist arrow '↗' or Lucide ArrowUpRight that translates +2px top-right on hover.

navbar.bg: bg-[#050505]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 text-white sticky top-0 z-50
navbar.logo: Includes /septa-logo.png mark (height ~36px) alongside uppercase Space Grotesk wordmark 'SEPTA GROUP'
navbar.links: English-only architectural links: ABOUT, SERVICES, PROJECTS, ECOSYSTEM, CONTACT
navbar.actions: Language Toggle + 'GET A QUOTE ↗' primary CTA

footer.bg: bg-[#050505] text-white border-t border-white/14 py-20 px-6 lg:px-12
footer.elements: Large architectural wordmark SEPTA GROUP (clamp 40px-90px), quick links, address in Kerala, technical metadata in IBM Plex Mono, copyright notice

admin_panel_design.sidebar: bg-[#050505] text-white border-r border-white/10 w-64 min-h-screen p-6 font-display
admin_panel_design.tables: Dense architectural scannability, 1px solid #DADAD7 borders, IBM Plex Mono table headers and ID metadata, high contrast text
admin_panel_design.forms: Monochrome inputs with 1px border-[#DADAD7], focus:border-[#050505] focus:ring-0 rounded-[3px], crisp typography
admin_panel_design.action_buttons: Dark solid #050505 primary buttons, ghost 1px border secondary action buttons

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements. Use kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Inject Google Fonts URL into public/index.html and update src/index.css / tailwind.config.js with font families ('Space Grotesk', 'Inter', 'IBM Plex Mono').
2. Set up CSS variables for design tokens (--septa-black: #050505, --septa-grey: #606060, --off-white: #F6F6F3, etc.) in src/index.css.

3. Apply site-wide section rhythm on HomePage and subpages: Hero (Black), Intro (Off-White), Capabilities (White), Selected Project (Black/Image), Process (Black), Projects (Off-White), CTA (Black), Footer (Black).
4. Ensure Navbar displays the /septa-logo.png logo + Space Grotesk 'SEPTA GROUP' wordmark on both light/dark contexts.
5. Rebrand Admin Panel with dark #050505 sidebar and crisp #F6F6F3 table/content environment with IBM Plex Mono metadata labels.
6. Remove all color gradients, soft blurred glassmorphism, or rounded bubbly pill components (except small category filter tags if necessary).
7. Attach data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and tabs across the application.
